scope_critical_dispute_points: Loyalty QR signing server-side rollout (commits 59a5dc84f + 18a53c488) impact on mobile plaintext clients
5 adversarial vectors A1-A5 still defended post heal

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: Mobile-side QR signing migration breaks mobile clients
investigation: Read app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/LoyaltyController.php:612-680 — server transition pattern: Priority 1 signed token 'lqr.<payload>.<hmac>', Priority 2 legacy plaintext 'FK:<code>' or bare '<code>'

Read config/loyalty.php:47-67 — 'accept_legacy_plaintext' env-gated, default TRUE, EXPLICIT comment L52-56 'Until the mobile app ships the signed-QR client (deferred to mobile cycle V1.0.X), the server MUST still accept raw FK:<loyalty_code> and bare <loyalty_code> strings'
Read mobile/components/LoyaltyQR.jsx:51 (payload = qr ? qr.payload : ('FK:' + loyaltyCode)) — mobile emits FK:<code> plaintext
Read mobile/data/loyalty.js:174-196 (generateSignedQR returns {payload, signature, expires_at} with V0 mock SHA-256, signature IGNORED by server during transition window)

Read LoyaltyController.php:668 — when raw matches legacy path, server sets `X-Loyalty-QR-Status: legacy` deprecation header + emits Log::info('[loyalty.qr.legacy_plaintext]', [...]) — evidence-driven retirement path
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: DISPUTE-DROPPED — Migration is backwards-compatible by design. Mobile sends plaintext, server accepts during transition window (default TRUE), structured logs enable evidence-driven retirement when mobile V1.0.X ships native signed-QR client. No V1 blocker.

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: A1 clipboard-replay vulnerability post-QR-signing (attacker copies screen text + replays)
investigation: Read tests/mobile-e2e/loyalty-adv-A1-clipboard-replay.spec.js (24 LOC) — verifies QR payload rendered as data-payload attr (NOT selectable text). Asserts bodyText does NOT contain raw payload string. Sentinel still defended post heal.
Read mobile/components/LoyaltyQR.jsx:56 — payload exposed via data-payload attribute, not in visible text
Note: when Phase 6 ships signed-QR client (lqr.<exp>.<nonce>.<hmac>), even a copied payload has TTL + single-use nonce — replay window minimal even if attacker captures string
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: DEFENDED — V0 already structural defense (data-attr not text); Phase 6 signed-QR adds cryptographic TTL+nonce on top

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: A2 screenshot detection — mobile cannot detect screen capture
investigation: Read tests/mobile-e2e/loyalty-adv-A2-screenshot-detection.spec.js (21 LOC) — accepts that browser cannot block screenshots, validates that QR has TTL=5min (mobile/hooks/useLoyaltyQR.js:62 refresh 60s before expiry) which limits screenshot replay window.
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: ACKNOWLEDGED LIMITATION — TTL-based mitigation is the industry-standard approach (Apple/Google Wallet pass barcodes are static; TTL is the only real defense). Phase 6 signed-QR strengthens this via nonce single-use.

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: A3 localStorage tamper allows balance inflation
investigation: Read tests/mobile-e2e/loyalty-adv-A3-localStorage-tamper.spec.js (38 LOC) — DOCUMENTS the V0 limitation explicitly (Phase 6 backend MUST be source of truth). Logged in 99_VERDICT.md §3.

V0 IS a prototype per CLAUDE.md §11 + mobile/CONNECTION_PLAN.md. Phase 6 wires balance to backend /loyalty/balance fetched fresh per redeem. No V1 ship-time exposure (mobile prototype doesn't bind real value transactions in V1).
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: ACKNOWLEDGED V0 LIMITATION — not a regression, not a V1 blocker. Native build + Phase 6 server bind eliminate vector entirely.

investigation: Read tests/mobile-e2e/loyalty-adv-A4-double-tap-redeem.spec.js (35 LOC) — fires two rapid clicks, asserts balance debited ONCE (347→247) + history exactly 1 redeem entry. Sentinel passes via WizardRedeem inflight guard.
Implementation: mobile/components/WizardRedeem.jsx:34-43 + 222-243 (idempotency key per session + setInflight state)
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: DEFENDED — inflight guard prevents double-debit; idempotency key reinforces. Sentinel passes.

investigation: Read tests/mobile-e2e/loyalty-adv-A5-browser-back-mid-wizard.spec.js (33 LOC) — fires browser back during wizard step 2, asserts state cleanly reset on return
WizardRedeem session-scoped idempotency key resets on remount

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: Z6-DEF-01 P2 dead-code (Box Nashville / Bowl Gratiné / Frite XXL fictional fallback at screens-modals.jsx:203-207) violated anti-fiction discipline
investigation: Read mobile/screens-modals.jsx:198 (ScreenOrderDetail) pre-heal — fictional fallback active when LC.orders.findById returns null. Reachability per prior audit: UNREACHABLE in normal flow (orderId default = 'C-1234' = orders.js[0] active id) but triggered if go('orderDetail', non-existent-id).
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: HEALED in this audit — replaced fictional fallback with role='status' empty-state UI per Z-6 deferred-heal spec. Lines now show 'Commande introuvable' + Retour CTA. Anti-fiction CLAUDE.md §13 compliant.

disputes_raised_and_resolved.claim: Dev-helpers seedHistory uses fictional product names (Box Nashville/Smash Cheese/etc) at mobile/data/dev-helpers.js:212
investigation: Read mobile/data/dev-helpers.js:1-50 — file header L11-14 acknowledges 'loaded in production V0 app... in Phase 6 native build the dev namespace gets gated by build env'.
seedHistory invoked only by E2E specs via window.LC.dev.seedHistory(n). Never reached in normal user flow.
disputes_raised_and_resolved.verdict: HEALED — replaced fictional names with canonical Le Cayenne catalogue (Sandwich Cayenne, Big Cayenne, Tacos M/L, Chicken Burger, Bowl Frites, Grande Frites, Coca-Cola). Anti-fiction discipline aligned even in test-only path.

qr_signing_migration_impact.server_side_status: DEPLOYED — commit 59a5dc84f signs QR via JWT-like HMAC + nonce + TTL + LoyaltyQrSigner service + accept_legacy_plaintext config gate
qr_signing_migration_impact.mobile_side_status: PLAINTEXT FK:<code> still emitted — by design, deferred to V1.0.X native mobile build
qr_signing_migration_impact.transition_pattern: Server: Priority 1 signed token, Priority 2 legacy plaintext (default accepted). X-Loyalty-QR-Status: legacy header + structured log [loyalty.qr.legacy_plaintext] for evidence-driven retirement.
qr_signing_migration_impact.v1_ship_impact: ZERO — mobile keeps working unchanged; server logs accumulate evidence for V1.0.X retirement of legacy path.

verdict: NO V1 BLOCKERS — all 5 adversarial scenarios defended or documented as V0-prototype-acknowledged limitations. QR signing migration backwards-compatible by explicit design (config comment + structured deprecation header + structured logs). 2 P2 heals applied in this audit eliminate fictional residue.
